text:
emma_sales: BankTrust signed the POC. They want HIPAA-safe baseline + short high-frequency spikes around trading opens. Profile they gave: embeddings ~1.8k qps steady, chat gen ~900 qps steady, spikes 3x/day up to ~38k qps for ~3 minutes. They asked for recommended reserved commitment, autoscale + burst plan, and any security questionnaire items to pre-flag.

rory_se: congrats! quick clarifying Q: are spikes strictly cron windows or event-driven?

emma_sales: mostly cron-like: 09:58-10:02, 12:29-12:33, 15:48-15:52 (customer local TZ). They can provide exact cron specs.

rory_se: perfect. Predictable spikes -> preheat + short burst pool is viable. High-level suggestion: small committed baseline sized for steady load + separate burst pool that can scale fast for 3m windows.

lucas_eng: rough compute estimates I ran locally: one A100-80GB equiv handles ~1.6k qps for short-chat gen when using fp16+batching. Embeddings are cheap; a T4-equivalent handles ~3k qps. For their mix baseline I'd propose 2 A100-equiv + 1 T4-equiv. To reach 38k qps we need ~18–20 A100-equiv in burst.

priya_sre: ops constraints: 1) KV/prefix cache warming is mandatory else p99 balloons on first spike; plan a T-15m warm and T-5m burst spin. 2) Autoscale guardrails to avoid runaway costs; cap burst minutes and set fallback model. 3) Ensure burst pool placement inside same AZs as baseline to avoid cross-AZ latency.

ana_solutions: for POC runbook propose: preheat pipeline (rdctl preheat) at T-15m, open burst pool at T-5m, route traffic to dedicated cluster during spike; if queue depth > 40 then switch to quantized fallback model. Add rehearsals schedule (2 dry runs).

lucas_eng: sample autoscale snippet to include in runbook:
```yaml
autoscale:
  baseline_reserved: "2"         # A100-equivalents
  baseline_embeddings: "1"      # T4-equivalents for embeddings
  burst_pool_max: "20"          # A100-equivalents
  preheat_minutes: "15"
  spinup_buffer_minutes: "5"
  scale_up_metric: "gpu_util_or_queue_ratio"
  scale_up_threshold: "0.65"
  scale_down_cooldown: "10m"
  fallback_model: "gen-8bit-lite-v2"
  kv_prefixes: ["trade_prompts_v2"]
```

josh_fin: pricing approach: recommend hybrid for BankTrust — small committed baseline (2 GPUs) + burst-credit package in blocks (e.g., 60m/day equivalent for month). I'll draft a POC quote: prorated GPU-month + burst credits priced per A100-min.

priya_sre: security blockers to flag: HIPAA needs customer-managed KMS for PHI, local VPC (PrivateLink/VPC peering), SOC2 evidence, SCIM + SAML for provisioning, and audit logs for preheat events. For POC we can token-scrub PHI, but KMS + audit retention is a likely req.

ana_solutions: add a short customer checklist for the questionnaire: KMS yes/no, required retention window, egress IP allowlist, SOC2 attestation copy, on-prem runway?

emma_sales: BankTrust already expects KMS + monthly access reviews. On-prem not required immediately but they want path to private deployment. I'll include checklist in the proposal.

lucas_eng: implementation note: preheat tool must emit an audit line like `preheat:event_id=XXX started_by=customerA profile=trade_prompts_v2 duration=900s targets=200`. Priya, we'll include an exportable CSV for compliance.

infra_bot: infra-bot: reserved-pool "banktrust-poc" provisioning started (baseline=2 A100-equiv, embeddings=1 T4-equiv, burst_cap=20 A100-equiv) requested by lucas_eng at 2024-07-12T14:22:10Z.

rory_se: next steps: 1) confirm exact cron windows with BankTrust, 2) agree baseline commit (2 A100 + 1 T4) + burst-credit bundle size for the POC, 3) schedule 2 rehearse preheats and capture p99/queue metrics, 4) collect questionnaire answers (KMS, SCIM, SOC2). I'll own the runbook draft.

emma_sales: I'll send proposal + questionnaire this afternoon. Josh, can you post a quick POC stub price (2 GPUs + 60 min/day burst) by EOD?

josh_fin: on it. Will post numbers and a short pricing note here by 18:00 PT.

priya_sre: tagging @security for KMS signoff and audit retention timelines. Also we need to document how we will rotate preheat credentials if customer triggers from their side.

lucas_eng: I'll add a small how-to for the customer to run the preheat CLI if they want to initiate from their datacenter. Example: `rdctl preheat --profile trade_prompts_v2 --duration 900 --concurrency 250 --audit-id $(uuidgen)`.

emma_sales: thanks all, this is actionable. I'll update the thread with the questionnaire responses and the agreed cron windows once BankTrust replies. :thumbsup:

rory_se: will post the draft runbook link here when ready. Leaving thread for visibility.
